name: Gemini Audio Transcriber
tagline: Audio transcription with automatic multi-speaker diarization and recognition
description: Gemini Audio Transcriber leverages native audio understanding via the Gemini Interactions API to transcribe audio files into accurate verbatim transcripts. It supports multiple formats (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, etc.) and speaker diarization, producing output that pairs seamlessly with meeting-note formatters for structured meeting summaries.
